summary: Official state and municipal cadastral/map custodians were verified, but no anonymous safe native parcel ID plus polygon response was obtained. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-5874-pachuca.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Instituto Catastral del Estado de Hidalgo page identified the state cadastral authority and its mandate; accessible page shell required JavaScript and exposed no parcel schema.
Official municipal predial page states that predial records/services use a predial account number and municipal treasury procedures; no public parcel geometry endpoint exposed.
Official SITEP territorial/statistical viewer was found by discovery, but direct retrieval timed out; no schema, CRS or parcel response obtained.

Official state geoportal loaded an accessible shell naming Instituto Catastral del Estado de Hidalgo; the visible response exposed search and registration/login controls but no parcel layer schema or anonymous feature response.

Official state cadastral management system was identified; retrieval returned a gateway error in this attempt. Search evidence shows it requires a user account and password; no login or credentials used.
Official municipal map page exposed layers named Pachuca de Soto, AGEB Pachuca and Puntos Pachuca; no parcel layer or safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

Official state service record for municipal base-plan printing identifies the Ayuntamiento/IMIP service as in-person/request-based and describes boundaries, roads, neighborhoods and geographic elements; it does not establish parcel polygons.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude. No exact-point parcel query completed and no coordinate shift applied.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because no anonymous parcel feature service was verified; this is not evidence of parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Hidalgo state cadastral infrastructure plus Pachuca municipal territorial/cadastral map services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Custodian identity and portal existence verified; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable identity and citywide coverage unverified.

scopeLimits: The state cadastral management system requires authentication; no login or credentials were used.
The municipal base-plan service is request/print oriented and does not establish parcel-level geometry.
SITEP timeout, gateway error, JavaScript shell, or absent visible parcel layer are service-access limitations, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: A current authenticated or request-gated cadastral source may provide parcel data, and the public portals may have additional client-side layers, but no anonymous safe ID-plus-geometry response was verified in this attempt. Parcel completeness, legal status, update currency and stable native identity remain unverified.
